claims.classification: Closed original HasFrame/HostFrameEx/GdFrameEx construction; no whole-node closure.
claims.construction: The exact Upl fields, class-rank bound before the cyclotomic height, both strict classes, literal GalLink, all Ok/Big conditions, original seed and both original initial families.
claims.parity: The compensated residual character is EVEN; both psi^(-a) eta are ODD for a=1,2.
claims.duality_count: All global and real invariant terms vanish; only the auxiliary local term 2-1=1 survives.
claims.uniformity: C0 is independent of m for one fixed initial abelian E; no uniformity in E or bound on Selmer orders.
claims.quotient_review: Use inequality, not equality, for equivariant homomorphisms on the IMAGE of excluded inertia. No local decomposition embedding into G_{F,S'} is assumed.
claims.remaining: Integral FinA from the now-constructed frame and uniform FinEnd, global two-sided rigidity, and moving-family weighted Selmer bound.
claims.scope: Pinned-source authentication and source-range ledger only. Mathematical arguments are in the shared TeX file; no Lean rebuild or automated theorem proof.
